title: First readers, ii
venue: Arthur's site (newspaper cadence: six dailies + a Sunday)
logline: The counter says 212. Wood argues with a stick figure about a panel. The stick figure is right.

panels.composition: The garage. The monitor: the counter reads 212. WOOD. Six stick figures at the back now, one of them holding up a sign: PANEL 3 IS WEAK.

image.prompt: a young man turning from a computer whose counter reads 212 to face six small stick figures at the back of a garage panel, one holding up a crude sign, muddy digital flats
image.notes: Sign: PANEL 3 IS WEAK. Letter after.

balloons.text: Panel 3 is the turn. Every strip has a turn. Schulz—
panel 3 is the same joke as panel 2

image.prompt: a young man arguing with a stick figure holding a sign in his garage

panels.composition: Wood looking at yesterday's strip on the monitor. Panel 3. A long beat.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man looking at his own comic on a monitor with a long, dawning expression

panels.composition: Wood redrawing panel 3 on the table. The stick figure with the sign has put the sign down and is watching, arms folded, satisfied. The dog. The counter, off-panel, presumably 213.

image.prompt: a young man redrawing a comic panel at his table while a small stick figure stands beside him with arms folded, its sign set down, a dog on the floor

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy early-digital flats begin
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in over-wet watercolor

notes: The chorus gets a note right. The strip admits it, small.
